runtimeDeliveryModel.evm: Core semantics produce chain events and replayable projections. Users or services may fetch results from chain/indexer.
runtimeDeliveryModel.cloud: Core semantics produce the same state, but cloud runtime can treat the engine as a black box and push computed user messages directly.
